indexingRequest.title: Request Community Node indexing
indexingRequest.publicNotice: Request that the selected Community Node index this public topic.

indexingRequest.privateConfirmation: I agree to disclose this channel's read capability to the Community Node
indexingRequest.privateWarning: This Node can decrypt and index the channel. Consent applies only to this account, channel, and Node. New read capabilities are sent automatically when the epoch changes. Leaving, withdrawing this request, or withdrawing Node consent stops future sends. Status checks that send a capability still ask each time.
indexingRequest.privateStopHint: Withdrawal stops future epoch updates. Indexing requested by other members may remain.
